# Contributing to ndrive

## Start with the correct application

Use Node.js 22.13+ (Node.js 24 is also suitable). Run `npm ci`, copy `.env.example` to `.env`, generate `CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` as 64 hexadecimal characters, then run `npm start`. The default URL is http://localhost:4173. The first registered account becomes the owner. Docker Compose mounts `./data` into `/app/data`.

## Keep changes reviewable

Describe the observed problem and the behavior after your change. Keep one concern per pull request; avoid unrelated dependency updates and formatting churn. Read existing repository instructions before changing source.

## Verification

Run `python3 scripts/source-preflight.py` once that script is available. Before merging auth/storage changes, use a disposable instance and test setup, login, logout, provider connection, and upload/download with non-sensitive fixture files. No automated application test script is declared in package.json.

For browser changes, check 390 × 844, 768 × 1024 and 1440 × 900 viewports. Look for horizontal overflow, clipped controls, readable text and keyboard focus. Record the actual browser and dimensions; a screenshot alone does not prove the whole journey.

Useful end-to-end check: Create the first owner on a disposable instance, sign out/in, connect a test storage destination, upload a small fixture, list it, download it, and compare the downloaded bytes.

## Handle sensitive data

Never attach SQLite databases, session cookies, OAuth refresh tokens, provider-secrets.json, storage access keys or real personal files. Use disposable storage accounts and fixture files.

## Before opening a pull request

- Explain what changed and why.
- List commands actually run and their results; state skipped checks explicitly.
- Include reproducible steps for bug fixes and relevant screenshots for UI changes.
- Describe migration or rollback needs when changing persisted data.

tasks.title: Add dependency-free source syntax checks and CI

files..github/workflows/source-preflight.yml:
name: Source preflight
on:
  push:
    paths: ['**/*.js', '**/*.mjs', '**/*.cjs', '**/*.py', '**/*.html', '.github/workflows/source-preflight.yml']
  pull_request:
    paths: ['**/*.js', '**/*.mjs', '**/*.cjs', '**/*.py', '**/*.html', '.github/workflows/source-preflight.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: source-preflight-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  syntax:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: python3 scripts/source-preflight.py

# ndrive: troubleshooting and recovery

## Scope

This guide describes the checked-in application as reviewed on 2026-10-10. Confirm current source and deployment configuration before operating on live data.

## Local setup

Use Node.js 22.13+ (Node.js 24 is also suitable). Run `npm ci`, copy `.env.example` to `.env`, generate `CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` as 64 hexadecimal characters, then run `npm start`. The default URL is http://localhost:4173. The first registered account becomes the owner. Docker Compose mounts `./data` into `/app/data`.

## Diagnose the failing boundary

NDrive persists accounts, sessions and storage connections in SQLite under ./data by default. Browser-local IndexedDB files are separate from server/provider files. Back up the database and encrypted provider state using a consistent SQLite backup or stop the service before copying the data directory, including relevant WAL files. Keep the encryption key separately and securely: losing it prevents decryption of saved credentials. Restore to an isolated instance and test login plus a fixture download before replacing a working server. Google OAuth redirect URIs must match exactly. Leave new signups disabled unless intentionally enabled.

## Safe verification

Run `python3 scripts/source-preflight.py` once that script is available. Before merging auth/storage changes, use a disposable instance and test setup, login, logout, provider connection, and upload/download with non-sensitive fixture files. No automated application test script is declared in package.json.

Run `python3 scripts/check-local-setup.py` for a local configuration check (or static HTTP check for photobooth). This does not authenticate to remote providers or launch an application workload.

## Reproduce before changing data

Create the first owner on a disposable instance, sign out/in, connect a test storage destination, upload a small fixture, list it, download it, and compare the downloaded bytes.

Use fixture data and an isolated deployment. Keep the last working revision available. Record the runtime, affected route/provider and error status before retrying. Do not repeatedly retry a rate-limited upstream.

## Information safe to share

Never attach SQLite databases, session cookies, OAuth refresh tokens, provider-secrets.json, storage access keys or real personal files. Use disposable storage accounts and fixture files.

## After a recovery

Recheck the failing journey and one normal journey, confirm that persisted/browser-local data is still available where expected, and document any steps that could not be exercised.
